title: S/M/L only pick the Current size
lede: The reviewer marked note creation as only partly done because size and position were chosen apart: a size button dropped a Note in the middle of the view, and only a double-click chose where. Now S/M/L only set the **Current size**, and a double-click on empty Board is the one way to create a Note, at that size and under the pointer. `createNoteInView` and the cascade placement it used had no other caller, so they are gone.

files.question: What does clicking S, M or L do now?
files.summary: Calls `setCurrentSize` on the ui store and nothing else; renamed from `NewNoteButtons`, with names 'Small notes', 'Medium notes', 'Large notes' in a 'Size of new notes' group.
files.owns: The three toggle buttons and which one is pressed.
files.never: Creates, places or measures a Note, so it no longer needs the scroll container.
files.tested: `App.browser.test.tsx`: a size button creates no Note and keeps Editing; each size then sizes the next double-click's Note.

files.question: How is a Note created now?
files.summary: Only `createNoteAt`, which reads the Current size and centres the Note on the pointer.
files.owns: Creating a Note in the Current colour and size, and opening it in Editing.
files.never: Picks a place for a Note on its own: the pointer always gives the position.
files.tested: `notesActions.test.ts`: the Current size and colour, Editing, and distinct ids.

files.question: Where does the double-click reach the store?
files.summary: Unchanged: a double-click whose two presses were both on empty Board calls `createNoteAt`.
files.owns: Deciding that a double-click on empty Board creates a Note.

steps.title: Click L in the toolbar
steps.explain: The button only sets the Current size. No Note appears and an edited Note stays in **Editing**, since a press outside the Board is no Press target that ends it. The new browser test clicks all three buttons while a Note is being edited and checks both.

steps.title: Double-click empty Board
steps.explain: The Press module sees both presses on empty Board and calls `createNoteAt` with the pointer and the Board's size. It reads the Current size, so the Note is large and centred under the pointer: size and position are chosen together.

notes.title: No way to create a Note from the keyboard
notes.detail: Tab to S/M/L and Enter used to create a Note; now only a double-click does. The README's Keyboard paragraph now says creating Notes from the keyboard isn't built. The counter-argument: this is a step back for keyboard users, which a keyboard shortcut on the Board could fix later.

notes.title: The cascade placement is deleted, not kept unused
notes.detail: `placeInVisibleBoard` and its tests (about 200 lines) only served the buttons. ADR 0003 and the cross-browser checklist were updated to match. Coverage stays above the gate (98.67% lines).

notes.title: Checked in the browser only by looking
notes.detail: I looked at the toolbar in the dev server but didn't click through it, because the Board held your own Notes; please do. The behaviour is covered by the browser tests in Chromium and Firefox.
